// typescript 7 note: types and noUncheckedSideEffectImports are spelled out at the values TypeScript 5 already uses here, because TypeScript 7 (the native compiler, tsgo) changed both defaults: it no longer adds every @types package (generated code reads process.env), and it checks side-effect imports, which nothing declares for import "./globals.css". So tsc behaves as before, and tsgo --noEmit checks the same rules.
// exclude note: The .next globs in include are there so `next dev`/`next build` have nothing to add (they rewrite this file when a value they want is missing); exclude then drops the whole build dir. Next writes per-route type stubs under .next/types that import each route by path, and a stub for a deleted route dangles. The same rule as forge's app frontends.
